_comment: Bot data tuning. Every number here is a placeholder until playtesting.
_draft_rule_comment: How a drafted bot's starting skills are picked. random: all at random from skills.json. damage_guarantee: as random, but a bot that drew no damage skill swaps a skill for a random damage skill. non_strike_damage: as damage_guarantee, but the damage skill may not be the basic attack (basic_attack_effect_id), which every bot fights with anyway. TODO(decision: draft-rule).
_damage_effect_ids_comment: Skill effect ids that count as damage for the guarantee rules.
_basic_attack_effect_id_comment: Effect of the basic attack every bot keeps in fights (basic_attack in data/combat/combat_tuning.json). non_strike_damage does not count it.
